thread:
Maya Chen: FYI AssureBank follow-up — they sent a security checklist + a few blocking Qs on SSO/SCIM/RBAC before we can kick off the POC. Can we triage?
Alex Rivera: I can own the POC tech setup. need their SAML IdP metadata and a test account for SCIM (or API token).
Sam Henderson (AssureBank): Thanks Maya. We have the IdP metadata and a SCIM service account but need clarity on which domain verification method you support (DNS TXT vs email), and how role-to-team mapping works. Also concerned about cert rotation.
Maya Chen: Domain verification — we support DNS TXT and email-based validation. For enterprise customers we prefer DNS TXT for automation. Role mapping: we map SCIM groups to RBAC roles via rules in the Console (can pre-map in POC).
Priya Nair: A couple security Qs from our side for the checklist: is the SCIM endpoint behind mTLS or bearer token? how are SCIM tokens rotated? are audit logs exportable to their SIEM?
Alex Rivera: SCIM endpoints accept bearer tokens by default; we also support mutual-TLS for Private installs. Token rotation is supported via the Console (issue new token + revoke). Audit logs: exportable via S3/CloudWatch integrations or syslog for Dedicated/Private.
Kevin Liu: Legal note — AssureBank asked for SOC 2 type and data residency guarantees in the SOW. Can someone pull the compliance pack and a short note on committed regions for Dedicated?
Maya Chen: I'll attach our compliance overview in the follow-up email. For Dedicated we can commit to NA/EU regions — for APAC we need to confirm infra availability.
Sam Henderson (AssureBank): Also pricing question: if we need Dedicated with SAML + SCIM + 24/7 support, what is the delta vs hosted? Ballpark ok for POC approval.
Maya Chen: Ballpark for a small Dedicated pool (2xA100 equiv) + enterprise auth + 24/7 support: rough estimate sent offline — final number after sizing. Will include a POC discount line.
Alex Rivera: For the POC checklist I propose:
- Get IdP metadata (SAML XML) + test IdP account
- Provide SCIM service account or allow us to create a test user
- DNS TXT for domain verification (or email if blocked)
- Example role mapping file (we'll send a template)
- Agree on success criteria: auth flow end-to-end + group->role sync + token rotation test

I'll schedule a 60m runbook session. available tomorrow 11am PT or Thurs 9am PT.
Sam Henderson (AssureBank): Tomorrow 11am PT works. we'll send metadata in a separate email.
Priya Nair: For the POC please ensure we get an account that can demonstrate audit log retrieval and SCIM deltas (create/update/delete). We'll also test cert rotation, please include steps in the runbook.
Alex Rivera: noted — I'll add a section in the runbook for cert rotation and a small script to rotate the SP cert and confirm sessions remain valid. will post the runbook before the call.
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Alex: runbook + schedule invite (assigned) :calendar:
- Maya: compliance pack + regional commit note (assigned) :file_folder:
- Priya: add security testcases to checklist (assigned) :shield:
- Kevin: prep SOW checklist for SOC2/residency ask (assigned) :memo:

incbot: Reminder — please include customer email thread in the Salesforce opportunity before POC kickoff.
Sam Henderson (AssureBank): Appreciate the quick turnaround. we'll upload the metadata and test account creds to the secure upload link in the invite.
Maya Chen: Great — I'll confirm once I have the files and post the runbook here. :thumbsup:
